statement.detailedDescription:
I am disputing a charge of $99.99 from 'Streaming Service' which appeared on my statement on February 10, 2026. This charge is completely unauthorized as I cancelled my subscription with them on January 20, 2026. I received a confirmation email that my subscription for 'StreamFlix Premium' was successfully cancelled and would not renew after my current billing cycle ended on January 31, 2026.

Despite the cancellation, I was still charged for a new billing cycle. I checked my account on their platform, and it clearly shows that my subscription status is 'cancelled' and no active services are currently linked to my profile. I have not used their service since January 31, 2026, and certainly did not authorize any renewal or new subscription on or after that date.

I contacted 'Streaming Service' customer support on February 12, 2026, to resolve this issue. They informed me that my cancellation was processed, but there might have been a 'system glitch' that led to the charge. They offered to refund me, but said it would take 'up to 30 business days' which I find unacceptable for an error on their part. I believe this charge should be reversed immediately as it was for a service I no longer subscribe to and explicitly cancelled.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: Cardholder contacted 'Streaming Service' customer support on 2026-02-12. Merchant acknowledged cancellation but claimed a 'system glitch' for the charge. Offered a refund but stated a processing time of 'up to 30 business days'. Cardholder found this timeframe unacceptable.
statement.requestedResolution: Full credit for the unauthorized charge of $99.99.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this statement is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.riskAssessment: Low - Clear evidence of prior cancellation and merchant acknowledgment of potential error.
bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Initiate chargeback under Reason Code 4841. Request proof of cancellation confirmation from cardholder if available, and provide merchant with cardholder's detailed statement.
